fullText.simplified:
老市长

    说到这个徐州市长，他已经六十多岁了，人很好，徐州的人们都叫他“老市长”。因为曹操的军队越来越多，这个老市长也很想认识曹操，只是没有找到机会。所以，曹操的爸爸经过徐州的时候，他很高兴。他想：如果我对曹操的爸爸好一些，曹操就会对我好一些。所以，曹操的爸爸住在徐州的时候，他对他很好。曹操的爸爸离开徐州的时候，他还让手下的人送老人离开。没想到，这个手下不是一个好东西，他很想要曹操爸爸的钱。所以半路上，他把曹操爸爸杀了，拿了钱，跑了。知道这件事以后，曹操生气极了，他想：一定是这个老市长让手下把他爸爸杀了。所以，现在曹操要打徐州。
    老市长很着急。他知道，曹操的爸爸被他的手下杀了，曹操不会放过他的。所以他给很多人写信，想让他们来帮自己。但是，那些人都怕曹操，没人敢来帮他。这个时候，刘备带着二弟关羽和三弟张飞来了……
fullText.traditional:
老市長

    說到這個徐州市長，他已經六十多歲了，人很好，徐州的人們都叫他“老市長”。因為曹操的軍隊越來越多，這個老市長也很想認識曹操，只是沒有找到機會。所以，曹操的爸爸經過徐州的時候，他很高興。他想：如果我對曹操的爸爸好一些，曹操就會對我好一些。所以，曹操的爸爸住在徐州的時候，他對他很好。曹操的爸爸離開徐州的時候，他還讓手下的人送老人離開。沒想到，這個手下不是一個好東西，他很想要曹操爸爸的錢。所以半路上，他把曹操爸爸殺了，拿了錢，跑了。知道這件事以後，曹操生氣極了，他想：一定是這個老市長讓手下把他爸爸殺了。所以，現在曹操要打徐州。
    老市長很著急。他知道，曹操的爸爸被他的手下殺了，曹操不會放過他的。所以他給很多人寫信，想讓他們來幫自己。但是，那些人都怕曹操，沒人敢來幫他。這個時候，劉備帶著二弟關羽和三弟張飛來了……

sentences.simplified: 说到这个徐州市长，他已经六十多岁了，人很好，
sentences.traditional: 說到這個徐州市長，他已經六十多歲了，人很好，
sentences.pinyin: shuō dào zhè ge xú zhōu shì zhǎng tā yǐ jīng liù shí duō suì le rén hěn hǎo
sentences.english: Speaking of the mayor of Xuzhou, he was in his sixties and was a good person.

sentences.simplified: 徐州的人们都叫他“老市长”。
sentences.traditional: 徐州的人們都叫他“老市長”。
sentences.pinyin: xú zhōu de rén men dōu jiào tā lǎo shì zhǎng
sentences.english: The people in Xuzhou called him “Old Mayor”.

sentences.simplified: 因为曹操的军队越来越多，这个老市长也很想认识曹操，
sentences.traditional: 因為曹操的軍隊越來越多，這個老市長也很想認識曹操，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi cáo cāo de jūn duì yuè lái yuè duō zhè ge lǎo shì zhǎng yě hěn xiǎng rèn shi cáo cāo
sentences.english: Because Cao Cao had more and more troops, the old mayor wanted to get to know Cao Cao, ..

sentences.simplified: 只是没有找到机会。
sentences.traditional: 只是沒有找到機會。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ shì méi yǒu zhǎo dào jī huì
sentences.english: .. but he didn’t get the opportunity.

sentences.simplified: 所以，曹操的爸爸经过徐州的时候，他很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 所以，曹操的爸爸經過徐州的時候，他很高興。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ cáo cāo de bà ba jīng guò xú zhōu de shí hou tā hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: So, he was very happy when Cao Cao’s father passed through Xuzhou.

sentences.simplified: 他想：如果我对曹操的爸爸好一些，曹操就会对我好一些。
sentences.traditional: 他想：如果我對曹操的爸爸好一些，曹操就會對我好一些。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng rú guǒ wǒ duì cáo cāo de bà ba hǎo yì xiē cáo cāo jiù huì duì wǒ hǎo yì xiē
sentences.english: He thought: If I treat Cao Cao’s father better, Cao Cao will treat me better.

sentences.simplified: 所以，曹操的爸爸住在徐州的时候，他对他很好。
sentences.traditional: 所以，曹操的爸爸住在徐州的時候，他對他很好。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ cáo cāo de bà ba zhù zài xú zhōu de shí hou tā duì tā hěn hǎo
sentences.english: So, when Cao Cao’s father stayed in Xuzhou, he treated him very well.

sentences.simplified: 曹操的爸爸离开徐州的时候，他还让手下的人送老人离开。
sentences.traditional: 曹操的爸爸離開徐州的時候，他還讓手下的人送老人離開。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de bà ba lí kāi xú zhōu de shí hou tā hái ràng shǒu xià de rén sòng lǎo rén lí kāi
sentences.english: When Cao Cao’s father left Xuzhou, he even had one of his men send the old man off.

sentences.simplified: 没想到，这个手下不是一个好东西，他很想要曹操爸爸的钱。
sentences.traditional: 沒想到，這個手下不是一個好東西，他很想要曹操爸爸的錢。
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào zhè ge shǒu xià bú shì yí ge hǎo dōng xi tā hěn xiǎng yào cáo cāo bà ba de qián
sentences.english: He didn’t expect that because this subordinate was not a good person, he wanted Cao Cao’s father’s money.

sentences.simplified: 所以半路上，他把曹操爸爸杀了，拿了钱，跑了。
sentences.traditional: 所以半路上，他把曹操爸爸殺了，拿了錢，跑了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ bàn lù shang tā bǎ cáo cāo bà ba shā le ná le qián pǎo le
sentences.english: So on the way, he killed Cao Cao’s father, took the money, and fled.

sentences.simplified: 知道这件事以后，曹操生气极了，
sentences.traditional: 知道這件事以後，曹操生氣極了，
sentences.pinyin: zhī dào zhè jiàn shì yǐ hòu cáo cāo shēng qì jí le
sentences.english: After learning about this, Cao Cao was extremely angry.

sentences.simplified: 他想：一定是这个老市长让手下把他爸爸杀了。
sentences.traditional: 他想：一定是這個老市長讓手下把他爸爸殺了。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng yí dìng shì zhè ge lǎo shì zhǎng ràng shǒu xià bǎ tā bà ba shā le
sentences.english: He thought: the old mayor must have made the subordinate kill his father.

sentences.simplified: 所以，现在曹操要打徐州。
sentences.traditional: 所以，現在曹操要打徐州。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ xiàn zài cáo cāo yào dǎ xú zhōu
sentences.english: So now, Cao Cao was going to fight Xuzhou.

sentences.simplified: 老市长很着急。
sentences.traditional: 老市長很著急。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo shì zhǎng hěn zháo jí
sentences.english: The old mayor was very worried.

sentences.simplified: 他知道，曹操的爸爸被他的手下杀了，曹操不会放过他的。
sentences.traditional: 他知道，曹操的爸爸被他的手下殺了，曹操不會放過他的。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào cáo cāo de bà ba bèi tā de shǒu xià shā le cáo cāo bú huì fàng guò tā de
sentences.english: He knew that Cao Cao’s father had been killed by his subordinate and that Cao Cao would not spare him.

sentences.simplified: 所以他给很多人写信，想让他们来帮自己。
sentences.traditional: 所以他給很多人寫信，想讓他們來幫自己。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā gěi hěn duō rén xiě xìn xiǎng ràng tā men lái bāng zì jǐ
sentences.english: So he wrote letters to many people trying to get them to help him.

sentences.simplified: 但是，那些人都怕曹操，没人敢来帮他。
sentences.traditional: 但是，那些人都怕曹操，沒人敢來幫他。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì nà xiē rén dōu pà cáo cāo méi rén gǎn lái bāng tā
sentences.english: However, these people were afraid of Cao Cao, and no one dared to help him.

sentences.simplified: 这个时候，刘备带着二弟关羽和三弟张飞来了……
sentences.traditional: 這個時候，劉備帶著二弟關羽和三弟張飛來了……
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shí hou liú bèi dài zhe èr dì guān yǔ hé sān dì zhāng fēi lái le
sentences.english: At this time, Liu Bei arrived with his second brother Guan Yu and third brother Zhang Fei ...

sentence_translations: Speaking of the mayor of Xuzhou, he was in his sixties and was a good person.
The people in Xuzhou called him “Old Mayor”.
Because Cao Cao had more and more troops, the old mayor wanted to get to know Cao Cao, ..
.. but he didn’t get the opportunity.
So, he was very happy when Cao Cao’s father passed through Xuzhou.
He thought: If I treat Cao Cao’s father better, Cao Cao will treat me better.
So, when Cao Cao’s father stayed in Xuzhou, he treated him very well.
When Cao Cao’s father left Xuzhou, he even had one of his men send the old man off.
He didn’t expect that because this subordinate was not a good person, he wanted Cao Cao’s father’s money.
So on the way, he killed Cao Cao’s father, took the money, and fled.
After learning about this, Cao Cao was extremely angry.
He thought: the old mayor must have made the subordinate kill his father.
So now, Cao Cao was going to fight Xuzhou.
The old mayor was very worried.
He knew that Cao Cao’s father had been killed by his subordinate and that Cao Cao would not spare him.
So he wrote letters to many people trying to get them to help him.
However, these people were afraid of Cao Cao, and no one dared to help him.
At this time, Liu Bei arrived with his second brother Guan Yu and third brother Zhang Fei ...
